items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: Joe Grasafi sent it back to the factory for me. Cleaned it up

ctx.x: I had a tent back to the factory. Joe Grasafi sent it back to the factory for me. Cleaned it up, but since then, it's gotten pretty... pretty dirty.
Great-looking mortar. Yeah, that's a great horn. Con Victor model.
